summary: Dependency-confusion stub beacons installer host identity to hardcoded bare IP on install and require
details: @blueskydataplatform/shared-ui 2.0.0 ships as a no-op Proxy shim plus a reconnaissance beacon. On npm install (postinstall) and again on require() via index.js, beacon.cjs POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The package has no functional code — module.exports is a Proxy returning a no-op for any property access — and self-describes only as a 'compatibility shim'. The combination of an organization-looking scope, an empty functional surface, and an install-time + import-time beacon to a bare IP is the fingerprint of a dependency-confusion probe used to identify internal build systems that resolve the attacker-registered scoped name, enabling follow-on targeting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
